subject: Medford High School Stabbing Response
overview: A local news report details the aftermath of a stabbing incident at Medford High School, featuring safety concerns from the victim's mother. Authorities announced juvenile charges and increased police presence at the school.

items.title: Stabbing Incident and Family Response
items.summary: The mother of 17-year-old victim Jordan Pineda reported that she does not feel safe sending her son back to school following a stabbing in a campus bathroom.

items.title: Law Enforcement and School Security Measures
items.summary: Police confirmed that a juvenile has been arrested and charged in connection with the fight, and patrols will be increased at the school for the rest of the week.
